svg.title: Wireframe 01: Canvas
svg.desc: Canvas screen in Build mode. Navigation rail, top bar with save state, undo, redo, experiment picker and a disabled Run button with its reason. Palette of block types on the left, the coffee shop model in the centre with a newly added server_2 showing an error badge, the selected block's settings on the right, and the problems list under the canvas.
svg.text: Added just now: E131 until its output is connected
The 'out' port of 'server_2' is not connected to anything. Connect it to another block or to a sink.
'server_2' cannot be reached from any source.
